title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-10
lineage: AUD > Uher 5 inch open MR > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough but listenable audience tape that captures a high‑energy 1970 show with standout performances of Cold Rain & Snow, Alligator → The Other One and Not Fade Away.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source – cloudy and low‑fi by modern standards but surprisingly clear for 1970 material. The performance itself shines: the band is in top form, delivering incendiary jams on Cold Rain & Snow, Alligator → The Other One, Attics and a soaring Not Fade Away/NFA closing. Reviewers love the raw 1970 vibe despite the tape’s imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (70% weight) and acknowledge the recording is acceptable for an audience source from 1970, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is described as cloudy, blurry and low‑end, with occasional clapping bleed, but the mix remains audible and the ambience captures the hall crowd. Not a high‑fidelity soundboard, yet listenable for 1970 standards.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic 1970 set with seamless segues (e.g., Alligator into The Other One, Dark Star → St. Stephen → NFA → Lovelight). Reviewers note the band’s high energy and strong transitions throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone is praised; his melodic interplay with Weir on the NFA closer is called ‘extraordinary’ and a “mind‑meld”.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal/guitar blend with Garcia on the NFA close receives special mention.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's snare had problems at one point, as noted by a reviewer.
